outcome.technical: PHONE STACK: forced-colors.css's 52rem block (the file that holds the phone rules) now makes .topbar position:static and sets :root{--topbar-h:0px} as the no-JS answer. page-state.js gets pinnedPx(el), which returns an element's height only while getComputedStyle says it is sticky. measureStack() and markSpy()'s fold both use it, so the offsets follow the stylesheet with no second copy of the breakpoint. Why this form: the header filter row sits inside .topbar, and a child cannot be un-stuck from a sticky parent, so the only CSS-only form is the whole bar. On a phone that bar's three lines (title, document actions, filter row) are not what someone reading a table row needs; the section strip and the table's own filter bar are, and they stay pinned. Folding the row into a third disclosure would duplicate More filters. I used a viewport query because the cost is a share of the screen. No !important. MORE FILTERS: on a phone the open bar leaves the sticky stack, so opening it while stuck sent the panel above the screen (measured y -486..-106). A toggle handler in page-state.js scrolls the <details> to the nearest edge only when it is off screen. 'Off screen' starts at its scroll-margin-top, calc(var(--sticky-2) + var(--sp-0)), read back resolved, so a disclosure in a stuck desktop bar counts as on screen and the page never moves. SCOPE: the row is no longer labelled 'Global filters' (group name: 'Report filters, each naming the section it narrows'). Visible labels are 'Author (usage)', 'Area (phases)', and 'Worked from … to … (phases & usage)', with the scope in a .gfscope span. Each control's accessible name starts with its visible label. The words follow the side nav's section names. DATES: both pairs now read 'Worked from' / 'to' ('From', 'Worked between' and 'and' are gone). A11Y: #audit-count has aria-live=polite. The summary's aria-label is removed: Chromium's AX tree now names it 'More filters · 1' (de21866c: 'More filters'), and the ▾/▴ ::after glyph gets an empty alt via the cascade fallback content:'x'; content:'x' / '' (Baseline newly), so the arrow is not read. Labelled role=group on #audit-phase-status, each phase's .tf-chips ('Filter <pid> tasks by status'), and every More-filters chip row through one helper, _report_html._chip_row, which emits the visible label and the group name from one string. Also on the Usage author chips (#audit-authors, aria-label 'Author') in _usage_overview.py, which the orchestrator added to the task's scope. FOCUS: the three box-shadow-only field focus rules became one rule in controls.css (#audit-q, .frow date, .gfilters select/date). It keeps the accent border and ring and adds outline:2px solid transparent, which Chromium's forced-colours emulation repaints in a system colour while dropping the shadow (measured with a probe before writing it). The report's CSS now contains zero outline:none. TESTS: test__report_html sc1-sc4, ax1, ax2; test__report_page pg23, pg24; test_render_report fo1, fo2, st1-st3. check-report-interactive: ph2 sits inside the existing phone More-filters branch, right after the sticky-share check it extends. ph1 measures the resting stack as what a reader sees: the first point down the screen's middle that is the table's frame. Bound: half the screen, because 'the table keeps most of the screen' means over half (basis in the comment); before 61%, after 33% (279px). Both use PHONE_TALL = 390x844, kept apart from PHONE_VIEWPORT so the recorded layout-baseline shares are not re-based. Also added: an interaction-state table (is1-is10, each control's own computed style at rest vs in hover/focus, plus the outline under forced colours for focus), ax3 (summary name read from the AX tree over CDP), and FEATURE_ABSENT rows for the two conditional sites. Stale claims fixed: comments and docstrings calling the row global or sticky at every width, the product README line (plugins/audit/README.md, now in scope), both ui READMEs (forced-colors.css's row claimed forced-colours rules it does not hold). FOLLOWERS: examples/report.sh re-rendered acme plus its .md and refreshed docs/index.html; docs/demo-large.html re-rendered per --how; screenshots re-captured (exit 0). check-rendered-artifacts --before-commit OK (3 match). Runs: task gate 4/4 files, 818 cases; full sweep 196/196 files, 18854 cases, exit 0; vitest 57 files, 853 tests; browser gate on acme exit 0, 229 checks, coverage 189 of 202 sites with 13 conditional; ruff and vermin clean. DEPENDANTS: shell.css, controls.css and forced-colors.css are read by _ui_theme/_ui_theme_lints and their tests by basename; the part list is unchanged and the theme lints pass in the sweep. panel-css/usage-tab.css keeps its own twin of the summary rules, unchanged, so its pin in test__panel_page uf7 still holds. Its arrow also lacks an empty alt, but the panel summary has no aria-label; noting this as a low for the orchestrator rather than changing the panel. motion-and-print.css print rules: the on-paper checks stay green (the bar and panel never reach paper). page-state.js readers (_report_ui, heatmap.js, test__report_ui, test__ui_theme_lints): still correct, sweep green. filters.js: net diff empty (an early draft was moved to page-state.js because the refresh() slice pins scale and tv-r2b read the next function's span). tools/ui-tests test-gate-filter passes. capture-screenshots.mjs: unchanged and green. examples, docs/index.html and demo-large are re-rendered. _report_page.py importers (render-report, tests, tools/where.py): signatures unchanged. CASE BINDING: ph1, ph2 and is1-is10 are printed by check-report-interactive.mjs, not by the submit command, so the drive will report entries 1-11 as gaps. st1-st3 are listed under entry 1 as the printed pins of the same behaviour.
